pages.title: Kampagnen
pages.purpose: List email campaigns (draft, scheduled, sending, sent) and create a new one.

pages.empty: EmptyState 'Noch keine Kampagnen.' / 'Eine Kampagne ist eine E-Mail an viele: an Tags oder alle aktiven Mitglieder, sofort oder geplant.' + 'Neue Kampagne'
uxNotes: Campaigns are soft-deleted (trash from the campaign page) but there is no trash view or restore anywhere.
No search, filter or ⋯ menu; sidebar label 'E-Mail-Kampagnen' vs page title 'Kampagnen'.
A one-field sheet only to name the campaign before the real editor page – an extra step.

redesign.desktop: <ListToolbar> search · Status FilterMenu · (event chip) · Segments on the right. Table: Name (+ Betreff), Status badge (colour per state, date when scheduled), Empfänger:innen, Datum.

pages.title: Kampagne (name)

menu.label: In den Papierkorb

sections.title: Empfänger:innen
sections.description: email.audienceHint, or 'Geht an {count} Personen.' once chosen

sections.title: Versand
sections.notes: Only while editable (draft/scheduled + email.manage). Buttons submit the same form with intent=test|schedule|send.

actions.label: Test an mich
actions.result: saves, then toast 'Test an {email} verschickt.' or email.noProvider

pages.phone: Aside (audience, sending) stacks below the content card.
uxNotes: 'Jetzt senden' mails the whole audience with no confirmation and no recipient count on the button (count is in the audience card description, only after saving).
Recipient count only refreshes after a save; changing tags shows no live reach.
Send/test/schedule buttons sit inside the edit form and also save it, while the SaveBar is the separate save path.
After sending, the page shows totals only; no per-recipient list (the send log is a separate, unfiltered page).
Audience = tags or active members only; no link to preview who exactly is included.

redesign.job: Write the campaign, pick who gets it, test it, then send or schedule it; afterwards see how it went.

Area page shows a description sentence (guide: no intro sentences on overviews).

research: Mailchimp / Brevo / Loops: a campaign is one page that reads top to bottom as a checklist (To · Subject · Content), with 'Send test' and 'Schedule / Send' as the last step; 'Send' always names the audience size in a confirm; sent campaigns open on their report (sent, delivered, bounced). Automations are a list with trigger, delay and an on/off state. Sending log = a filterable activity list. Templates/branding live in settings. Taken: views Kampagnen · Automationen · Versand as Segments on one area page; the campaign page opens on its state with 'Jetzt senden' (count in the confirm) as the next step; test/schedule submit the one form; E-Mail-Vorlagen under the gear.
